nodes.label: Dashboard Builder Prompt Template
nodes.rationale: Template for dispatching a general-purpose subagent as the dashboard's UI/UX specialist with a final spec ({SPEC}); the model is set explicitly because an omitted model silently inherits the session's most expensive one. Success is never claimed without serve evidence (daemon running + root div loads).

nodes.label: Never Modify Synced Files
nodes.rationale: main.tsx, index.css, lib/utils.ts, hooks/, and components/ui/ are synced from the main app; editing them desyncs the dashboard from every other Vesta surface.

nodes.label: Read-Only Browser Verification
nodes.rationale: Pages are backed by live user stores (the tasks page reads and writes real tasks), so browser verification is read-only: load, render, measure, never click controls that can write. If interaction is genuinely required, create throwaway data, interact only with that, and delete it before reporting.
